stem: Mild damage is found on 2 plants, then 7, then 15 across three comparable scouting rounds. What is the most important evidence?
choices: The first count is the only valid count
Mild severity means no action is ever needed
The crop is automatically diagnosed with one pest
The increasing incidence trend supports escalation even if individual severity remains modest
rationale: The increasing incidence trend supports escalation even if individual severity remains modest. This preserves the Course 005 identity, crop-care, scouting, biosecurity, authority or record-quality principle being assessed.
